title: AWS, Cloud & Cloud-Native Architecture
intro: AWS interview questions are unavoidable in any cloud-leaning backend interview — the core compute services (EC2 vs ECS vs EKS vs Fargate vs Lambda), RDS and Aurora and DynamoDB, S3 and storage classes, IAM (roles vs users, least privilege, the trust policy that always confuses), the messaging stack (SQS vs SNS vs EventBridge vs Kinesis), serverless patterns with Lambda + Spring Cloud Function, and the production-debug scenarios interviewers actually ask ("the AWS bill doubled overnight — debug it"). For vendor-agnostic cloud-native patterns (12-factor, deployment strategies, DR) see the Cloud Native page; for GCP and Azure see the dedicated platform pages.
